Test 14
For each question, choose the correct answer.
The teenage jewellery maker
Eighteen-year-old Jasmine Holloway writes about how she started her successful jewellery-making business.
When I was 15, I just wanted everything my friends had, and I never planned ahead - for example, I had no idea what I wanted to do when I left school. One day, my best friend got a new phone for her birthday and, of course, I thought I should have one, too. My parents said I could only have it if I paid for it with my own money, so I decided to work part-time and save as much as I could. I owe my parents a lot for making me do that - it taught me a really valuable lesson.
I worked every Saturday in a cafe, but I didn't really enjoy it, so my parents suggested starting my own little business instead. I'd seen my mum making necklaces for herself, so I asked if I could have a go at that. I'd never imagined I'd find it so easy, as it had seemed so complicated when I'd watched Mum doing it. My friends thought it sounded dull, but I was really into the idea. Mum had shown me it was possible to create something attractive at home using basic tools and materials.
I sold my first items of jewellery to my friends and family as soon as I'd finished making them. They told me they were delighted with them, of course, but I just thought they were saying that to please me. So although I was grateful they'd bought them, I still needed convincing that they looked good enough to be popular with the public.
There was only one way to find out, so I rented a market stall with my mum. There are always lots of tourists where I live, and they bought lots of my things to give to family and friends when they got back home. Soon we were receiving calls from all over the country from people asking to buy more. They thought we were a big business, employing loads of people to produce my designs, when in fact we were just two people on a market stall. That was when I knew it could work, and it was time to take the next step and set up a website.
Since then, I've made thousands of pounds through my business, mostly online, although we still have our stall, too. It's been such a lot of fun so far.
Jasmine wanted to save money
A. to buy a present for a friend.
B. to pay for her future studies.
C. to buy something for herself.
D. to pay her parents back for something.
Before Jasmine started making jewellery herself, she thought she would
A. find it difficult to do.
B. need special equipment.
C. get bored of it quite quickly.
D. be unable to produce anything nice.
How did Jasmine feel when people bought her first items of jewellery?
A. She was disappointed by her family's and friends' comments.
B. She wasn't surprised that the buyers were so pleased.
C. She was glad that she'd finally managed to sell them.
D. She wasn't confident about the quality of her designs.
Why did Jasmine decide to set up a website?
A. Her jewellery market stall wasn't especially successful.
B. People from other areas wanted to buy her jewellery.
C. She wanted to work with other jewellery makers.
D. Her jewellery company had become so large.
What would Jasmine write on the homepage of her website?
A. Only available on the internet, my designs are produced by a team of expert jewellery makers, and are of the highest quality.
B. My parents taught me all they know about making jewellery and starting a business, but now I run the whole thing myself.
C. Having given up my cafe business to create jewellery, I now have time to make the beautiful products on this site.
D. Because of my decision to earn money for myself, I now produce this beautiful jewellery and I'm very grateful for my family's help.

options.label: A
options.text: to buy a present for a friend.

options.label: B
options.text: to pay for her future studies.

options.label: C
options.text: to buy something for herself.

options.label: D
options.text: to pay her parents back for something.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jasmine 想省钱是因为 “my best friend got a new phone... I thought I should have one, too. My parents said I could only have it if I paid for it”（为自己买手机），对应 C 选项 “为自己买东西”。A 选项 “给朋友买礼物”、B 选项 “支付未来学费”、D 选项 “偿还父母” 与原文 “想买朋友有的新手机” 不符。

questions.text: Before Jasmine started making jewellery herself, she thought she would

options.label: A
options.text: find it difficult to do.

options.label: B
options.text: need special equipment.

options.label: C
options.text: get bored of it quite quickly.

options.label: D
options.text: be unable to produce anything nice.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jasmine 开始做珠宝前，“I'd never imagined I'd find it so easy, as it had seemed so complicated when I'd watched Mum doing it”（认为会很难），对应 A 选项 “认为做起来困难”。B 选项 “需要特殊设备”、C 选项 “很快会厌倦”、D 选项 “无法生产好东西” 与原文 “看着妈妈做觉得复杂，实际容易” 不符。

questions.text: How did Jasmine feel when people bought her first items of jewellery?

options.label: A
options.text: She was disappointed by her family's and friends' comments.

options.label: B
options.text: She wasn't surprised that the buyers were so pleased.

options.label: C
options.text: She was glad that she'd finally managed to sell them.

options.label: D
options.text: She wasn't confident about the quality of her designs.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jasmine 卖出第一批珠宝时，“I still needed convincing that they looked good enough to be popular with the public”（对设计质量不自信），对应 D 选项 “对设计质量不自信”。A 选项 “对家人朋友的评论失望”、B 选项 “不惊讶买家高兴”、C 选项 “高兴终于卖出” 与原文 “认为他们只是取悦自己” 不符。

questions.text: Why did Jasmine decide to set up a website?

options.label: A
options.text: Her jewellery market stall wasn't especially successful.

options.label: B
options.text: People from other areas wanted to buy her jewellery.

options.label: C
options.text: She wanted to work with other jewellery makers.

options.label: D
options.text: Her jewellery company had become so large.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jasmine 决定建立网站是因为 “we were receiving calls from all over the country from people asking to buy more”（其他地区的人想购买），对应 B 选项 “其他地区的人想购买她的珠宝”。A 选项 “市场摊位不太成功”、C 选项 “想与其他珠宝制造商合作”、D 选项 “珠宝公司已变得很大” 与原文 “市场摊位受欢迎，被误认为大公司” 不符。

questions.text: What would Jasmine write on the homepage of her website?

options.label: A
options.text: Only available on the internet, my designs are produced by a team of expert jewellery makers, and are of the highest quality.

options.label: B
options.text: My parents taught me all they know about making jewellery and starting a business, but now I run the whole thing myself.

options.label: C
options.text: Having given up my cafe business to create jewellery, I now have time to make the beautiful products on this site.

options.label: D
options.text: Because of my decision to earn money for myself, I now produce this beautiful jewellery and I'm very grateful for my family's help.

questions.explanation: 解析：D 选项 “因为我决定自己赚钱，现在生产这种漂亮的珠宝，我非常感谢家人的帮助” 与原文 “父母建议创业，妈妈教制作” 一致。A 选项 “仅在互联网上提供，由专家团队生产” 与原文 “开始只有母女俩” 矛盾；B 选项 “父母教了所有知识，现在独自经营” 与原文 “妈妈教制作，后建立网站” 不符；C 选项 “放弃咖啡馆生意” 与原文 “不喜欢咖啡馆工作，未提及放弃” 不符。
